        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_presilting_plane_cover {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (hR : IsEFinite R) {V : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (g : ProjectiveClass R →+ V) (P Q : FiniteProjective R) (hspan : ∀ (v : V), ∃ (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ), a • g (ProjectiveClass.of P) + b • g (ProjectiveClass.of Q) = v) :
        ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R × TwoTerm R)), (∀ p ∈ s, (p.1.directSum p.2).IsPresilting) ∧ ∀ (v : V), ∃ p ∈ s, v ∈ sectorBetween (g p.1.projectiveClass) (g p.2.projectiveClass)

        If two projective classes span the space, E-finiteness gives a finite cover of that whole space by sectors of compatible presilting pairs.
